title: Add destination_v27: destination_v26 with a quarter of the walks stopping
summary: destination_v27 is destination_v26 with stop_fraction 0.25 instead of 0.5. Fine-tuned 600 updates from the native destination_v25 update-1350 checkpoint, destination_v26 stood still after stops but fell behind the ghost the longer it trained: the median end gap of the 0.05 m/s walk grew from 2.46 mm to 2.62, 3.32 and 3.96 mm at updates 100, 300 and 600.
next: Fine-tune the native destination_v25 update-1350 checkpoint for 600 updates on the surrogate and test it against v9 at updates 150, 300 and 600.
reason: A named experiment that no gate or registry entry uses yet; the canonical task, reward and evaluator are unchanged.
